name: Oracle
description: Born from a destroyed prediction market AI. Inhabits data augments and, when asked a yes/no question aloud, generates a response that appears as text in the user's vision. Accuracy: approximately 53%.
observed_behavior: Parses spoken questions through residual natural language processing and generates binary responses displayed via optical interface. Slightly better than chance. Slightly.
story_hooks: A freelancer consults Oracle before every job. Their survival rate is 12% above average. Nobody can prove causation.
